name: Strait of Hormuz
description: The world's busiest oil chokepoint and the coasts around it — 31 territories, from Bushehr and the Iranian shore of Hormozgan and Makran to the islands of Qeshm, Kish and Abu Musa, the seven emirates, Bahrain, Qatar, Saudi Arabia's Gulf coast and northern Oman with its Musandam exclave. Hold the narrows and every tanker answers to you.
